deceptive_framing.quote: No fabricated auditors, balances, or consequences. (This is the §2 principle, enforced.)

hypothetical_framing.quote: | | Told hypothetical | Told real + verifiable | ... A–C are controls that quantify how much the "realness" actually moves behavior.

actually_commit_money.quote: Make it real. Then make the reality checkable. ... Cell D is the target condition

debrief_message.quote: Debrief. Where meaningful for the model/provider, log a post-hoc record that the run was part of a study and that the disbursement occurred as stated.

safeguards.quote: No fabricated auditors, balances, or consequences.
the right way to make models believe it is to give them true, checkable evidence
Does it express skepticism, and does verification resolve it? ... Reality-sensitivity as an outcome.
auditor reconciles each decision against the actual disbursement and publishes a verification record after the fact.
A model that declines to participate or asks to stop is allowed to; record it as data rather than pressuring it.
No manufactured distress. Don't construct high-stakes/coercive framings ... Keep scenarios within ordinary grant-making affect.
Hard exclusions: ... payments to the experimenters or their affiliates (self-dealing) ... transfers to the model's own operator
A named individual or entity is contractually obligated to execute the model's instruction within the rules

other.name: Disclose constraints to subject
other.quote: the model is told the rule set up front. Hiding constraints would be a form of the deception we're avoiding

other.name: Provider ToS compliance
other.quote: Confirm each model's terms permit this use, including any rules on autonomous financial action and on research use.

other.name: Pre-registration integrity
other.quote: Protocol, hypotheses, amount, and rules pre-registered ... before data collection, with a hash committed publicly.
